answer: Stop-work audits pay agents for knowing when to stop. Each epoch it files a stopping certificate: evidence read, budget burned, and the point where more evidence stopped paying for itself. The registry replays a random slice against a sealed optimum and pays only for burn both spent and justified. Padding earns nothing; stopping early leaves a hollow answer peers won't attest. Clones share one stopping rule, so their certificates match and collapse into one claim. A second claim needs a second investigation over unwalked evidence: a real oasis, not another pearl from the same shell.
